  • Instagram Video Downloader

  • Help?

How Can I Download Stories?

Download Instagram stories and highlights (#highlights)

  • 1. First, enter the Instagram username
  • 2. After continuing, you will see an area where the stories and highlights are listed
  • 3. Then, you can easily download videos and photos from stories to your computer or phone. That’s it!
  • Start

Questions and Answers

❓ How can I download stories from Instagram?

To download Instagram stories, the account must be public.

Next, go to StorySaver.net and enter the Instagram username of the account you want to download stories from to start the process.

Finally, you will see the current stories of the entered username. Click the download link below each story to successfully download it.

💡 How can I download Instagram highlights?

To download Instagram highlights, the account must be public.

Then, go to StorySaver.net and enter the Instagram username, and click the Download! button.

Next, you’ll see a list of albums representing the highlights of the selected account. Choose an album, view the stories inside, and click the download link below each story to save it.

📱 How to download Instagram stories on iPhone?

You can download Instagram stories on your iPhone using third-party downloader apps or through the Safari browser. Due to device limitations, the download feature works only on iOS 13 or higher. Visit StorySaver.net, enter the username, and start downloading with a single tap.

📲 How to download Instagram stories on Android?

The most stable way to download Instagram stories on Android is through the Chrome browser. Go to StorySaver.net, follow the steps, and save the stories you want to your device within seconds.

💻 How to download stories on Windows or Mac laptop?

The most stable way to download Instagram stories on Android is through the Chrome browser. Go to StorySaver.net, follow the steps, and save the stories you want to your device within seconds.

💾 Do you keep records of downloaded content?

Absolutely not! Storing users’ personal data goes against our privacy philosophy. We never log or save any activity!

About Instagram Story Downloader

Easily download Instagram stories and highlights. No app required! Just one tap is enough.
The simplest and most convenient way to download Instagram stories and highlights to your computer or phone.

StorySaver.net

Download Instagram Stories and Highlights
No App Required! Simple and Easy to Use.

  • Download Instagram Stories

  • How Can I Download Stories?

Download Instagram Stories




  • Instagram Video Downloader
  • Instagram Story Downloader

  • Help?

How Can I Download Stories?

Download Instagram stories and highlights (#highlights)

  • 1. First, enter the Instagram username
  • 2. After continuing, you will see an area where the stories and highlights are listed
  • 3. Then, you can easily download videos and photos from stories to your computer or phone. That’s it!
  • Start

Questions and Answers

❓ How can I download stories from Instagram?

To download Instagram stories, the account must be public.

Next, go to StorySaver.net and enter the Instagram username of the account you want to download stories from to start the process.

Finally, you will see the current stories of the entered username. Click the download link below each story to successfully download it.

💡 How can I download Instagram highlights?

To download Instagram highlights, the account must be public.

Then, go to StorySaver.net and enter the Instagram username, and click the Download! button.

Next, you’ll see a list of albums representing the highlights of the selected account. Choose an album, view the stories inside, and click the download link below each story to save it.

📱 How to download Instagram stories on iPhone?

You can download Instagram stories on your iPhone using third-party downloader apps or through the Safari browser. Due to device limitations, the download feature works only on iOS 13 or higher. Visit StorySaver.net, enter the username, and start downloading with a single tap.

📲 How to download Instagram stories on Android?

The most stable way to download Instagram stories on Android is through the Chrome browser. Go to StorySaver.net, follow the steps, and save the stories you want to your device within seconds.

💻 How to download stories on Windows or Mac laptop?

The most stable way to download Instagram stories on Android is through the Chrome browser. Go to StorySaver.net, follow the steps, and save the stories you want to your device within seconds.

💾 Do you keep records of downloaded content?

Absolutely not! Storing users’ personal data goes against our privacy philosophy. We never log or save any activity!

About Instagram Story Downloader

Easily download Instagram stories and highlights. No app required! Just one tap is enough.
The simplest and most convenient way to download Instagram stories and highlights to your computer or phone.
